auto.data_is_stored_in_a_postgresql_database: Data is stored in a PostgreSQL database hosted on Google Cloud (Cloud Run + Cloud SQL). All traffic is encrypted in transit via HTTPS/TLS. Passwords are hashed and never stored in plain text. We apply the principle of least privilege: each component only accesses the data it needs.
